description_en: Queries servers in a server group of a Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
description_zh: 查询网络型负载均衡服务器组中的服务器列表
kebab_example: aliyun nlb list-server-group-servers --server-group-id sgp-atstuj3rtoptyui0000 --server-ids i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --server-ips 192.168.6.3 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 20 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServerGroupServers

parameters.help_en: The ID of the server group
parameters.name: server_group_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the backend servers. You can specify up to 40 backend servers in each call
parameters.help_zh: 服务器ID列表。单次调用最多支持展示40个服务器
parameters.name: server_ids

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses of the backend servers. You can specify up to 40 backend servers in each call
parameters.help_zh: 服务器IP列表。单次调用最多支持展示40个服务器
parameters.name: server_ips

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token used to specify a particular page of results. Valid values:

Left this parameter empty if this is the first query or the only query.
Set this parameter to the value of NextToken obtained from the previous query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return in each call. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the NLB instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
网络型负载均衡实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/443657.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If this is your first query or no next query is to be sent, ignore this parameter.
If a next query is to be sent, set the parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值

Description.description_en: The description of the backend server

Port.description_en: The port that is used by the backend server. Valid values: 1 to 65535
Port.description_zh: 后端服务器使用的端口。取值范围：1~65535

ServerGroupId.description_en: The ID of the server group

ServerId.description_en: The ID of the server group

ServerIp.description_en: The IP address of the backend server

ServerType.description_en:
The type of backend server. Valid values:

Ecs: Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance
Eni: elastic network interface (ENI)
Eci: elastic container instance
Ip: IP address
ServerType.description_zh:
后端服务器类型，取值：

Ecs：ECS实例。
Eni：ENI弹性网卡实例。
Eci：ECI弹性容器。
Ip：IP地址

Status.description_en:
The status of the backend server. Valid values:

Adding
Available
Configuring
Removing
Status.description_zh:
后端服务器的添加状态。取值：

Adding：添加中。
Available：正常可用状态。
Configuring：配置中。
Removing：移除中

Weight.description_en: The weight of the backend server

ZoneId.description_en: The zone ID of the server
